title: Network Postback Integration Manual
deck: Standardizes partner integration between Adjust and the networks (Meta/Google/TikTok/Apple). One misconfigured postback can wreck a network's machine-learning optimization — every integration goes LIVE only after passing this procedure.
summary: A postback is the channel through which the MMP (Adjust) delivers attribution results back to each ad network. Every network goes through three steps: (1) partner activation, (2) postback mapping, (3) macro verification. Meta/TikTok are SAN (Self-Attributing Networks); Google/Apple run a SAN+S2S hybrid by default.

items: Install Postback — sent to the network on each new install. The core learning signal for ML optimization.
In-App Event Postback — sent when in-app events (signup, purchase, etc.) fire. Required for tCPA/tROAS bidding.

content.html: For SAN networks, Adjust doesn't issue click URLs — the network supplies its own click/view data to the MMP. Meta, Google, TikTok, Snap, X, and Apple Search Ads are the main examples.

rows: AEM priority list of 8 events required
Separate SKAN postback channel for iOS
Map ASA campaign IDs to the App Token
Verify MAX bidding vs Direct separately

items: Adjust dashboard → the app → open Partner Setup
Search the partner → click + Add Partner
Enter credentials (Meta = Pixel ID, Google = Linker ID, TikTok = Advertiser ID)
Sending Settings: send only Install + Tier-1 in-app events
Fire install/events from a sandbox test device → confirm receipt in the network dashboard (up to 24h delay)

content.html: On iOS 14.5+, AEM allows at most 8 events. Place the highest business-value events at the top. Enable value optimization only on revenue-bearing events.

content.html: UAC requires a Firebase connection. Either mirror Adjust events into GA4, or send Adjust → Google Ads directly. Direct sending loses less data and is the primary recommendation.

content.html: Non-SAN networks (Moloco, LINE, etc.) require Adjust macros embedded in the click URL. The network substitutes each macro with its own value at click time.

rows: Campaign identifier. Matches the network campaign ID 1:1

content.title: Installs report as 0 in the network dashboard
content.html: 1) Check the Install Postback toggle in Adjust → Partner Setup. 2) Never issue a separate click URL to a SAN network — double tracking misclassifies traffic as organic. 3) Confirm a Sandbox token isn't being used in Production.

content.title: Cost data shows 0 in the Adjust dashboard
content.html: Per-network Cost API integration is a separate opt-in. Adjust → App Setup → Cost Data → register each network's API key. Meta = System User Access Token, Google = Ads API auth. Initial sync takes 24–48 hours.

content.title: Probabilistic matching share is high
content.html: When iOS 14.5+ users decline ATT, IDFA is masked and deterministic matching is impossible. Adjust falls back to IP+UA fingerprinting, but networks like Moloco don't trust it. Run those networks on a single SKAdNetwork channel instead.
